title: Brother, Can You Spare a Dime?
writers: Jay Gorney (music) and E. Y. Harburg (lyrics)

evidence.note: Written for the 1932 revival of the musical revue 'Americana' and published by Harms, Inc. in 1932.
Confirms the 1932 Harms, Inc. copyright of the sheet music.

famous_use: Bing Crosby's recording for Brunswick Records was aired heavily on radio weeks after the show opened, helping popularize the song.
